explication: GlobalBuildingAtlas provides global building footprints, estimated heights and LoD1 models. Its documented development workflow covers satellite-image building-map extraction and polygon refinement, height inference, footprint fusion, and LoD1 generation; users can then derive final LoD1 GeoJSON from released polygon and model data. The repository also includes a geospatial dataset/transform library and plotting utilities. Several implementation stages are documented but not sampled, so those links are labeled from the README; source-level edges are limited to relationships visible in excerpts or the SOURCE INDEX.
